blocks.text: A room in the Garter Inn.
Sir, the Germans desire to have three of your horses; the Duke himself will be tomorrow at court, and they are going to meet him.
What duke should that be comes so secretly? I hear not of him in the court. Let me speak with the gentlemen; they speak English?

lines.text: Ay, sir; I’ll call them to you.

blocks.text: They shall have my horses, but I’ll make them pay; I’ll sauce them; they have had my house a week at command; I have turned away my other guests. They must come off; I’ll sauce them. Come.
